sources.title: Google launches Gemma 3 270M: a compact fine-tuning AI model optimized ...
sources.snippet: Google has unveiled Gemma 3 270M, a 270-million parameter AI model designed for instruction-following, fine-tuning, and energy-efficient deployment. It's available now for download, testing, and fine-tuning on various platforms.

sources.title: Gemma 3 270M: Small Yet Powerful, a Lean Model Born for Ultra-Efficient AI
sources.snippet: Google introduces Gemma 3 270M, a lightweight AI model with only 270 million parameters, born for task-specific fine-tuning. It not only boasts powerful instruction-following capabilities but also features extreme energy efficiency, making it the ideal starting point for building fast, low-cost, and privacy-preserving custom AI applications.
